label: Email (IMAP/SMTP)
description: Read, file and send mail from Yahoo, AOL, iCloud, Zoho, Fastmail, GMX or any IMAP mailbox

operations.name: search_messages
operations.description: Find messages in a folder, newest first, with their headers and the start of each.

operations.name: get_message
operations.description: One message whole: its headers, text, HTML and attachments (kept as files). Reading it doesn't mark it read.

operations.name: send_email
operations.description: Send an email from this mailbox over its SMTP server.

operations.name: reply_to_message
operations.description: Reply to a message from this mailbox, in its thread: to its sender, or with Reply all to everyone on it.

operations.name: move_message
operations.description: Move messages to another folder: Archive, Trash or one of yours. Nothing is ever deleted for good.

operations.name: list_folders
operations.description: The mailbox's folders, with which one is Sent, Trash and so on.

operations.name: check_connection
operations.description: Sign in to the IMAP and SMTP servers, sending nothing, and show the newest senders in the inbox.

operations.name: on_new_email
operations.description: Runs for each new message in a folder that matches the filters.
